lines: A tree's down on the Old Town–Hillside line. Tonight Hillside is only reachable from Riverside.
Not everyone will make it home on time.
nightCard.footnote: Rumour on the line: someone leaves a lantern lit at Old Town, but only for the first train through.

platform.headline: Tonight, someone will wait.
platform.coach: One question tonight. People don't always tell you everything until you ask. Your promise is what you'll be held to.

passengers.name: Tomás
passengers.ask: One more late and I'm done. Eleven years, and I've never once called in.

onTime.line: Clocked in at quarter to, on the dot. Nobody said a word. Good.
onTime.logLine: Quarter to, on the dot. Nobody said a word.

late.line: The manager said nothing. Then: “Friday's your last shift.”
late.carry: Friday becomes Tomás's last shift. He'll still ride.

notReached.line: He called in. He's never called in before.
notReached.carry: Friday becomes Tomás's last shift. He'll still ride.

passengers.name: Agnes
passengers.ask: Well. The wool shop shuts at quarter to. One sleeve left, and if I miss it, it's the old grey. He hates grey.

onTime.line: The shopkeeper was pulling the shutter. She held up the last sleeve, and he let her in.
onTime.logLine: He was pulling the shutter. He let her in.

late.line: Shutter down. She'll finish it in the old grey.
late.carry: Agnes will finish the scarf in grey, and she'll say so.

notReached.line: She went home and unpicked her own cardigan for the wool.
notReached.carry: Agnes will finish the scarf in grey, and she'll say so.

passengers.name: Priya
passengers.platform: Mind if I scribble? Half a chorus and no ending.
passengers.planQuote: Half a chorus and no ending.
passengers.ask: Band's running the set at quarter to. If I'm not there, they'll cut my song.

onTime.line: They ran the set twice. Her song stays in.

late.line: They cut her song from Thursday. She says she'll change their minds.
late.carry: Wednesday Priya rides for a second chance to win her song back.

notReached.line: The band texted the setlist. Her song wasn't on it.
notReached.carry: Wednesday Priya rides for a second chance to win her song back.

passengers.name: Wen
passengers.platform: He asked for me today. By name.
passengers.planQuote: He asked for me today. By name.
passengers.ask: Good days are rare now. The nurse says come before quarter past, while he's still awake.

onTime.line: He was awake. He knew her straight away.

late.line: He'd fallen asleep. She sat with him anyway, until the nurse said go.
late.logLine: He'd fallen asleep. She sat with him anyway.
late.aside: She steps off without looking back. Then, at the gate, she lifts a hand.
late.carry: Wen boards quieter: “He didn't wake. That's all right.” Friday is her big night, and she hasn't forgotten Tuesday.

notReached.line: She stood at the locked door and phoned the night desk.
notReached.carry: Wen boards quieter: “He didn't wake. That's all right.” Friday is her big night, and she hasn't forgotten Tuesday.

variants.platform: Told to come in early tonight. Twenty-five to, or don't bother.
Last night I only got the glass. He asked for me today, by name.
Missed rehearsal yesterday. Half a chorus to make up for it, and no ending.

coach.text: Tonight is Tomás's final warning. You promised {promised}. Click a glowing station to start.
Three of four is the most anyone can do tonight, and every way to get three leaves Tomás waiting. Saving him costs someone else.
You promised {promised}. On this route, they won't make it.
Two of four. {waiting} would wait. Is it worth it? Only you can say.

logbook.tomorrow: Wednesday is Agnes's big night. Her grandson's ferry leaves at half past.
